triggering_evidence.outcome: Final evaluation completed, but the exact completion-budget invariant rejected the result after the training reserve stopped collection.
Through checkpoint 1, end-to-end training throughput was within approximately two percent of the L40 while the calibrated reserve left less training time.

hardware_preference.from: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 on RunPod secure cloud
hardware_preference.to: NVIDIA L40 on RunPod community cloud

rationale.runtime: The scientific compute budget is the exact 320 sampled completions, not elapsed wall time. The original wall-clock envelope was too short to reliably consume that fixed budget and then run the unchanged final evaluation.
rationale.hardware: Measured end-to-end workload throughput on the RTX 5090 did not justify its higher rate. The L40 passed reserve calibration and is the lowest-cost observed worker with sufficient memory.
rationale.study_integrity: No revision-31 condition had produced an accepted result when this amendment was recorded. The protocol and source are refrozen before rerunning any factorial cell.
